label: Today
description: Compact automatic plan tracking, one new finding, and the existing progress section.

label: Insights · Overview
description: Saved fixed goals in one Filter Insights row, optional AI review, and takeaway-first goal cards.

label: Insights · More Goal Cards
description: Activity and energy summaries use the same Explore more about [Goal Name] footer.

label: Be More Active
description: A complete period comparison with sample context, followed by a possible connection.

label: Better Digestion
description: The approved stomach icon, supported percentages, and explicit missing sample context.

label: More Energy
description: Local energy comparison; device-only information is supporting text, never a navigation label.

label: Better Sleep
description: A missing direct comparison can coexist with a relevant connection and plan.

label: Connection Evidence
description: Sleep and activity linked without a causal arrow; explicit comparison groups and counts.

label: Plan · Today’s Records
description: Automatic statuses derive from required log fields, with Add Entry and View Entry actions.

label: Plan · Manage
description: Pause Plan and End Plan are full-width outlined buttons with distinct icons and emphasis.

label: AI Review · Takeaways
description: Three short takeaways link back to the underlying goal comparison or connection evidence.

label: AI Review · Explanation
description: Expanded explanation, explicit sharing scope, and suggested follow-up questions.

label: Contextual Follow-Up Chat
description: Visible finding context, a sample exchange, and an editable follow-up composer.

label: Goal · Gathering Context
description: The exact fixed goal name and the specific missing evidence; no invented progress score.

label: Plan · Paused
description: Resume Plan replaces Pause Plan; diary records remain available.

label: Plan · Assessment
description: Insufficient comparable records are an assessment outcome, not success or failure.

label: Insights · AI Off
description: Local goal summaries and plans remain available when AI features are off.

label: Insights · Early Records
description: Saved goals remain discoverable while comparisons are still taking shape.

label: Insights · Care Notice
description: A report-level care notice remains above filtered content; this does not define a clinical trigger.
